summary: Provision shared 'model-eval-results' Slack channel with PR-thread sync, Confluence digest, and Jira-thread trigger
description:
Issue summary: Request to create a new cross-pod Slack channel named #model-eval-results that centralizes CI/CD PR notifications, model evaluation run summaries, and manual threaded discussion. The channel should be restricted so only members of the Model Evaluation, Model Onboarding, and Runtime Ops groups can post; read access should be organization-wide (read-only for observers).

Background: Several pods (model-eval, runtime, infra, data) are currently duplicating discussion threads across private channels and PRs. This causes missed reviews and fragmented postmortems. A single shared channel with automated sync to Confluence and the ability to convert a Slack thread into a Jira issue (into the Model-Eval project) will improve traceability and make runbook creation easier.

Request details:
- Create channel #model-eval-results (private posting; org-readable).
- Install/enable PR-to-thread bot: when a PR is opened against github.com/redwood-inference/models or /automation with label "model-eval", post a top-level message and start a thread that links back to the PR. New commits/CI checks should append into the thread.
- Add a Slack-to-Confluence digest job that posts a daily summary of top threads (ranked by reactions) into Confluence page: Model Eval Daily Digest.
- Enable a Jira-create-from-thread action (button) that creates an INT-prefixed issue in the Model-Eval project and links the Slack thread URL to the issue. Default issue type should be Task with label "from-slack".
- Retention policy: auto-archive channel after 90 days of inactivity; messages retained for 90 days. Provide per-message export capability for compliance.

Constraints and requirements:
- Bot/service-account must use least-privileged permissions; approvals required from Security.
- Posting restriction: only members of these AD/Okta groups should be able to post: model-eval-core, model-onboard, runtime-ops. Others added as guests only.
- Must honor existing DLP rules and message redaction for PII.

Acceptance criteria (must pass for closure):
1) Channel created with correct name, privacy and posting restrictions.
2) PR-to-thread integration posts for a sample PR in automation and models repos; thread links back to PR and updates on commit/CI status.
3) Confluence daily digest page receives a summarized post automatically for 24h window during test run.
4) Jira-create-from-thread successfully creates a ticket in Model-Eval project with thread link and proper labels.
5) Security confirms bot permission scope and provides approval comment.

Timeline: Requested start 2026-03-11; target soft launch to a pilot group by 2026-03-20.

Notes: This is a coordination ticket: Slack admin, DevOps automation, Security, and Model Eval owners need to sign off.
acceptance_criteria: Channel exists named #model-eval-results with private-posting, org-readable
